name: CBS housing
policy: Review annual CBS release and geometry changes; retain source years and unknown values.

name: NWB roads and municipal observations
policy: Quarterly; regenerate observations and heat data together after roads change, verify source hashes and complete months.
refresh: npm --prefix website run data:streets; npm --prefix website run data:street-observations

name: Amsterdam housing tax rates
policy: Annual official-source review; never estimate missing next-year rates. Year and check date belong to housingTaxSource.
refresh: Manually verify official rates and update taxes.ts with regressions.

name: B&B demo scenario
policy: Annual check of boundary source and explicit simulation labels; simulated figures are never current permit counts.

name: BAG, trees, labels, noise and address context
policy: Live on explicit selection, dated model years retained; quarterly API-contract review. Refetch failure preserves prior value with a stale status in screen and export.
refresh: Run source-contract tests and a documented live sample; do not bulk-query private addresses.
